_doc: Static news/updates feed — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH, no backend/API. Any update/announcement/release MUST be appended here as a new item, newest first. Both surfaces read it LOCALLY: web imports it at build time, Flutter bundles it as an asset — clicking/tapping an item opens its detail from this same local data (works offline, no fetch). Lists are PAGINATED via `pageSize`. Dates ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Images live on Cloudflare R2 — `image` is the full R2 public URL. Per item only id/date/image/i18n are required; version/link/cta/pinned/tags/author are optional. `link` = external 'read more' URL; `cta` = action-button URL whose label is `i18n.<locale>.cta`. title/summary/body/cta are per-locale — mirror frontend/messages/.
